name: Connors RSI(2) pullback above 200-day SMA
author: Larry Connors / Cesar Alvarez (via FMZ)
summary: Buy short-term oversold dips (2-period RSI below 10 or 5) only in an uptrend above the 200-day SMA, sell on a close above the 5-day SMA; claimed high win rate on index ETFs.
notes: Book version has no stop loss; short side (RSI2 > 90 below 200 SMA) omitted as the source focuses on longs.

name: Connors R3 (three-day RSI(2) decline)
author: Larry Connors (tested by Quantified Strategies)
summary: Above the 200-day SMA, buy after RSI(2) falls three days in a row starting from below 60 and ends below 10; exit when RSI(2) > 70.
long_entry: close > sma(close, 200) & rsi(close, 2) < 10 & rsi(close, 2) < shift(rsi(close, 2), 1) & shift(rsi(close, 2), 1) < shift(rsi(close, 2), 2) & shift(rsi(close, 2), 2) < shift(rsi(close, 2), 3) & shift(rsi(close, 2), 3) < 60
notes: Original is for stocks/ETFs; applied as written.

name: Trading Rush MACD + 200 EMA ('tested 100 times')
author: TradingRush (YouTube) / TradingView port
summary: Long when MACD crosses above signal below the zero line while price is above the 200 EMA (short mirror); stop at swing, target 1.5R. Famous YouTube video claiming a 62% win rate.
notes: Swing-point stop and 1.5R target approximated by fixed 5%/7.5% fractions plus an opposite-cross exit; original is intraday. The TradingView port's description says longs need the cross ABOVE zero; the original TradingRush video requires the cross BELOW zero (used here). Port uses swing stop over the last 5 bars.

name: Triple EMA 9/21/55 crossover
author: TradingView community
summary: Enter long when EMA9 crosses above EMA21 while EMA21 is above EMA55 (short mirror); the 55 acts as trend filter.
notes: Source suggests % or ATR stops with R:R target; exit on reverse fast cross used instead.

name: Bollinger Bands + RSI double strategy
author: ChartArt (TradingView) / LuxAlgo library
summary: Buy when price closes below the lower Bollinger band while RSI(14) < 30, sell short on the mirror; target the middle band.

name: Larry Williams volatility breakout (open + k*range)
author: Larry Williams (popularised for crypto bots in Korea)
summary: Buy when price rises above today's open plus k times yesterday's range, exit at the next open; the standard Korean Upbit crypto-bot strategy with k=0.5.
notes: Original is an intraday stop entry with exit at next open; on daily bars approximated as: daily close above the trigger -> hold one day (exit condition always true).

name: Raschke/Connors Holy Grail (ADX > 30 pullback to 20 EMA)
author: Linda Raschke / Larry Connors (Street Smarts)
summary: In a strong trend (ADX > 30, rising), wait for a pullback to the 20 EMA and buy a break of the pullback bar's high; target the recent swing high.
long_entry: adx(14) > 30 & plus_di(14) > minus_di(14) & shift(low, 1) <= shift(ema(close, 20), 1) & close > shift(high, 1)
short_entry: adx(14) > 30 & minus_di(14) > plus_di(14) & shift(high, 1) >= shift(ema(close, 20), 1) & close < shift(low, 1)
notes: Stop entry above setup bar approximated by close above prior high; exit = prior swing extreme or 3-bar trailing stop.

name: Minervini Trend Template adapted to BTC
author: Mark Minervini
summary: Hold only when price > 50 > 150 > 200-day SMAs, 200-day rising for a month, price >= 25% above 52-week low and within 25% of 52-week high.
long_entry: close > sma(close, 50) & sma(close, 50) > sma(close, 150) & sma(close, 150) > sma(close, 200) & sma(close, 200) > shift(sma(close, 200), 21) & close >= 1.25 * lowest(low, 252) & close >= 0.75 * highest(high, 252)
notes: Relative-strength rating vs other stocks dropped; exit on a close under the 50-day (Minervini's common sell discipline) since the template itself is a filter.

name: BTC 200-week MA reclaim
author: TradingView idea author
summary: Bitcoin's 200-week MA marks bear-market floors; buy when price moves back above it, sell when it closes below.
notes: 200 weeks approximated as 1400 daily bars.

name: Tom Lee rule #3: own Bitcoin above its 200-day
author: Tom Lee / FS Insight
summary: Buy Bitcoin when it is above its 200-day moving average; forward 6-month returns were far higher above it than below.

name: BTC 200-day SMA checked monthly
author: Seeking Alpha contributor
summary: Check once a month: hold Bitcoin if it is above the 200-day SMA, otherwise cash; claimed to cut drawdowns versus buy-and-hold.
notes: Monthly evaluation on the last day of the month. Source site blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403) but the article URL is valid.

name: Pi Cycle Top: hold until 111DMA crosses 2x350DMA
author: Philip Swift (LookIntoBitcoin)
summary: Bitcoin cycle tops coincided (within 3 days) with the 111-day SMA crossing above 2x the 350-day SMA; used as a sell signal, re-entering once the 111DMA falls back below.
notes: The indicator only defines the top/exit; re-entry rule (111DMA back under 2x350DMA and price above 350DMA) added to make it a strategy.

name: Mayer Multiple accumulate/take-profit
author: Trace Mayer / Preston Pysh
summary: Price / 200-day SMA: accumulate when the multiple is low (< 1, or below 2.4 in Mayer's original simulations), take profit above 2.4.
notes: Original 2.4 threshold came from Mayer's simulations; lower buy thresholds (1.0, 0.8) come from community variants.

name: Bull Market Support Band (20W SMA + 21W EMA)
author: Benjamin Cowen (popularised) / TradingView
summary: Bitcoin is in a bull phase while it trades above both the 20-week SMA and 21-week EMA; below the band is bearish.
notes: Weekly averages approximated with daily lengths 140 and 147; weekly-close evaluation not reproduced.

name: Bitcoin 2-Year MA Multiplier
author: Philip Swift (LookIntoBitcoin)
summary: Buy when price falls below the 2-year moving average, sell when it rises above 5x that average; historically marked cycle bottoms and tops.
notes: 2 years = 730 daily bars (crypto trades 7 days).

name: Connors Double 7
author: Larry Connors / Cesar Alvarez
summary: Above the 200-day SMA, buy a close at a 7-day low and sell at a close at a 7-day high; no stops; ~80% winners on S&P 500.

name: Raschke Turtle Soup (failed 20-day breakout)
author: Linda Raschke / Larry Connors (Street Smarts)
summary: Fade new 20-day lows/highs: when price makes a fresh 20-day low but closes back above the prior 20-day low (set at least 4 bars earlier), buy; mirror for shorts.
long_entry: low < lowest(low, 20, 1) & close > lowest(low, 20, 1) & lowest(low, 20, 1) < lowest(low, 4, 1)
short_entry: high > highest(high, 20, 1) & close < highest(high, 20, 1) & highest(high, 20, 1) > highest(high, 4, 1)
notes: Intraday buy-stop above the old low approximated by a close back above it; the 'old low at least 4 bars ago' approximated by the 20-day low being below the last 4 bars' lows; exit = 3-bar trailing stop or 5-day high (source: profits within 2-6 bars).

name: DeMark TD Sequential buy setup 9
author: Tom DeMark
summary: Nine consecutive closes below the close four bars earlier marks seller exhaustion; buy on completion of the 9-count (sell setup mirrors).
long_entry: close < shift(close, 4) & shift(close, 1) < shift(close, 5) & shift(close, 2) < shift(close, 6) & shift(close, 3) < shift(close, 7) & shift(close, 4) < shift(close, 8) & shift(close, 5) < shift(close, 9) & shift(close, 6) < shift(close, 10) & shift(close, 7) < shift(close, 11) & shift(close, 8) < shift(close, 12)
long_exit: close > shift(close, 4) & shift(close, 1) > shift(close, 5) & shift(close, 2) > shift(close, 6) & shift(close, 3) > shift(close, 7) & shift(close, 4) > shift(close, 8) & shift(close, 5) > shift(close, 9) & shift(close, 6) > shift(close, 10) & shift(close, 7) > shift(close, 11) & shift(close, 8) > shift(close, 12)
notes: Approximation: setup-9 only (no price-flip prerequisite, perfection or 13-bar countdown); long from buy setup until a sell setup completes. Entry fires on bar 9 and any later bar while the run continues.

name: Elder Impulse System
author: Alexander Elder (Come Into My Trading Room)
summary: Green bars (13 EMA rising and MACD histogram rising) permit longs, red bars permit shorts, blue bars are neutral; trade in the direction of the impulse.
notes: Elder uses the impulse as a veto on a higher timeframe; here traded directly with exit on the first non-green (non-red) bar.

name: TTM Squeeze fire (John Carter)
author: John Carter (Mastering the Trade)
summary: When Bollinger Bands (20,2) have been inside the Keltner Channel (20,1.5 ATR) and then expand outside it, trade in the direction of momentum; exit when momentum fades.
long_entry: shift(bb_up(close, 20, 2), 1) < shift(kc_up(20, 1.5), 1) & bb_up(close, 20, 2) > kc_up(20, 1.5) & close > sma(close, 20) & roc(close, 12) > 0
short_entry: shift(bb_lo(close, 20, 2), 1) > shift(kc_lo(20, 1.5), 1) & bb_lo(close, 20, 2) < kc_lo(20, 1.5) & close < sma(close, 20) & roc(close, 12) < 0
notes: Carter's momentum histogram (linear-regression based) approximated by 12-day ROC; 'exit on second fading histogram bar' -> two consecutive declines in momentum.

name: Buy BTC in extreme fear, sell in extreme greed
author: K33 Research (Vetle Lunde)
summary: Buy Bitcoin when the Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows extreme fear; K33 found positive median forward returns but warned of continued sell-offs.
notes: K33 studied forward returns, not a full exit rule; exit on extreme greed (> 75) follows the Buffett 'fearful/greedy' framing used in the article.

name: Seykota EMA crossover on BTCUSDT with ATR exit
author: Ed Seykota (method) / gregoirejohnb (TradingView)
summary: EMA crossover system 'as prescribed by Ed Seykota' applied to BTCUSDT: long on fast-over-slow EMA cross, exit on the reverse cross or an ATR-based stop, lengths chosen to reduce whipsaws.
long_exit: cross_below(ema(close, f), ema(close, s)) | close < highest(close, 50) - 5 * atr(14)
notes: Video does not print exact lengths; Seykota-style 15/150 and 20/200 pairs given as params; ATR trail anchored to the 50-bar highest close.

name: Turn-of-the-month (last 5 days to 3rd day)
author: Quantified Strategies
summary: Buy at the close five trading days before month end and sell at the close of the third trading day of the new month; similar return to buy-and-hold with half the drawdown on the S&P 500.
notes: Crypto trades every day so 'trading days' become calendar days.

name: Stochastic RSI crossover with 8/14/50 EMA alignment
author: StockSharp (popular YouTube 'Stoch RSI + 3 EMA' strategy)
summary: Long when Stoch RSI %K crosses above %D between 10 and 60 with EMA8 > EMA14 > EMA50 and price above EMA8; short mirror.
long_entry: cross_above(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), sma(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), 3)) & sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3) > 0.1 & sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3) < 0.6 & ema(close, 8) > ema(close, 14) & ema(close, 14) > ema(close, 50) & close > ema(close, 8)
short_entry: cross_below(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), sma(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), 3)) & sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3) > 0.4 & sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3) < 0.95 & ema(close, 8) < ema(close, 14) & ema(close, 14) < ema(close, 50) & close < ema(close, 8)
notes: Stoch RSI built from rsi/highest/lowest; source has no exit (ATR stop suggested), exit set to a close through EMA50.

name: Bitcoin Donchian 15/15 breakout with low-ADX filter (ChatGPT-designed)
author: Quantified Strategies
summary: Buy Bitcoin on a break above the 15-day high only when ADX(14) < 25 (breakouts from quiet consolidation), exit on a break of the 15-day low.

name: Bitcoin weekend/Monday effect
author: Quantified Strategies
summary: Mondays have historically been Bitcoin's strongest weekday (~+0.5% average); buy late Sunday, hold through Monday.
notes: Signal at Sunday close, position held during Monday, exit at Monday close (filled next bar).

name: IBS mean reversion (buy < 0.1, sell > 0.9)
author: Quantified Strategies
summary: Internal Bar Strength = (close-low)/(high-low); buy when it closes below 0.1 and sell when above 0.9; 70% winners on QQQ.

name: SuperTrend (ATR 10, x3) long-only flip
author: TradingView community
summary: Go long when SuperTrend(10,3) flips bullish and close when it flips bearish; the most-copied crypto TradingView strategy setting.
notes: Script uses SMA of true range for ATR; vocab supertrend_dir uses standard ATR.

name: Ichimoku Tenkan/Kijun cross above the cloud
author: Goichi Hosoda (method) / StockSharp
summary: Long when Tenkan crosses above Kijun with the close above the cloud; exit when Tenkan falls below Kijun or close drops below the cloud.

name: Bitcoin RSI 30/70 vs HODL
author: BGeometrics
summary: Buy BTC when daily RSI(14) drops below 30, sell when it rises above 70; returned ~60% vs ~1200% buy-and-hold in 2019-2021 (selling too early).

name: Stochastic Pop and Drop (Bernstein/Steckler)
author: Jake Bernstein / David Steckler (StockCharts ChartSchool)
summary: With the 70-day stochastic > 50 and ADX(14) < 20, buy when the slow 14-day stochastic surges above 80 on above-average volume; short the mirror 'drop'.
notes: Exit when the stochastic hooks back out of the extreme zone (LuxAlgo description of the pop).

name: Lambert CCI +/-100 breakout
author: Donald Lambert (StockCharts ChartSchool)
summary: Buy when CCI moves above +100 (entering a strong uptrend) and close when it falls back below +100; short below -100, cover above -100.

name: Bollinger %B + Money Flow Index
author: John Bollinger (Bollinger on Bollinger Bands)
summary: Buy when %B rises above 0.8 and MFI above 80 (strength confirmed by volume); sell when %B < 0.2 and MFI < 20.
notes: Bollinger suggests Parabolic SAR stops; treated as stop-and-reverse between signals instead.

name: Sy Harding seasonal timing with MACD (six-month cycle)
author: Sy Harding / Gerald Appel MACD
summary: Be long only in the favourable Oct 16 - Apr 20 window, entering once MACD is bullish and exiting after Apr 20 once MACD turns bearish.
notes: Equity seasonal applied to BTC unchanged.

name: 'Last' stochastic technique (39-period %K vs 50)
author: Encyclopedia of Technical Market Indicators (Colby/Meyers) via ChartSchool
summary: Buy when the unsmoothed 39-period %K crosses above 50 and the close exceeds the prior week's highest close; sell on the mirror.
notes: 'Previous week' = prior 7 daily bars for a 24/7 market; same-bar coincidence of cross and breakout required.

name: Ichimoku cloud pullback (above cloud, dip under Kijun, turn above Tenkan)
author: Arthur Hill (StockCharts ChartSchool)
summary: Bullish bias when price is above the cloud's lower line; buy when a pullback below the Base Line is followed by a move back above the Conversion Line; mirror for shorts.
long_entry: close > min(ichi_span_a(), ichi_span_b()) & lowest(close - ichi_kijun(), 5, 1) < 0 & cross_above(close, ichi_tenkan())
long_exit: close < max(ichi_span_a(), ichi_span_b()) & highest(close - ichi_kijun(), 5, 1) > 0 & cross_below(close, ichi_tenkan())
short_entry: close < max(ichi_span_a(), ichi_span_b()) & highest(close - ichi_kijun(), 5, 1) > 0 & cross_below(close, ichi_tenkan())
short_exit: close > min(ichi_span_a(), ichi_span_b()) & lowest(close - ichi_kijun(), 5, 1) < 0 & cross_above(close, ichi_tenkan())
notes: 'Pullback below Base Line' = a close under Kijun within the prior 5 bars; exit on the opposite signal.

name: NR7 narrow-range breakout (Crabel)
author: Toby Crabel (Day Trading with Short-Term Price Patterns)
summary: After the narrowest-range day of the last 7, buy a move above its high (sell a move below its low), expecting range expansion.
long_entry: shift(high - low, 1) <= lowest(high - low, 6, 2) & close > shift(high, 1)
short_entry: shift(high - low, 1) <= lowest(high - low, 6, 2) & close < shift(low, 1)
notes: Intraday stop entries approximated by closes beyond the NR7 bar; exit on a close back through the prior bar's opposite extreme (source gives no exit).

name: Moving Momentum (20/150 SMA + stochastic + MACD)
author: Arthur Hill (StockCharts ChartSchool)
summary: With the 20-day SMA above the 150-day, wait for the stochastic to dip below 20, then buy when MACD-histogram turns positive; mirror for shorts.
notes: MACD confirmation step taken from the full ChartSchool article; 'recent' stochastic extreme = within 5 bars.

name: Bollinger Band Squeeze breakout
author: John Bollinger / StockCharts
summary: When BandWidth is near the low of its six-month range, trade the first close outside the bands in the break direction.
long_entry: lowest(((bb_up(close, 20, 2) - bb_lo(close, 20, 2)) / sma(close, 20)), 10) <= 1.1 * lowest(((bb_up(close, 20, 2) - bb_lo(close, 20, 2)) / sma(close, 20)), 180) & close > bb_up(close, 20, 2)
short_entry: lowest(((bb_up(close, 20, 2) - bb_lo(close, 20, 2)) / sma(close, 20)), 10) <= 1.1 * lowest(((bb_up(close, 20, 2) - bb_lo(close, 20, 2)) / sma(close, 20)), 180) & close < bb_lo(close, 20, 2)
notes: 'Near the low' = within 10% of the 180-day BandWidth minimum in the last 10 bars; exit at the middle band (not specified in source).

name: Pocket pivot (Morales & Kacher)
author: Gil Morales / Chris Kacher
summary: Buy an up day whose volume exceeds every down-day volume of the prior 10 sessions while price is at/above the 10- or 50-day average and not extended; sell on a 50-day violation.
long_entry: close > shift(close, 1) & volume > highest(volume * (close < shift(close, 1)), 10, 1) & close > sma(close, 50) & close < 1.05 * sma(close, 10)
notes: 'Constructive base' judgement dropped; boolean multiplied by volume isolates down-day volume.

name: O'Neil follow-through day market entry
author: William O'Neil (How to Make Money in Stocks)
summary: After a correction, a day 4+ of a rally attempt that closes up strongly on higher volume confirms a new uptrend; buy then, step aside on trend failure.
long_entry: close < 0.85 * highest(high, 90) & lowest(low, 3) > lowest(low, 30) & close >= 1.015 * shift(close, 1) & volume > shift(volume, 1)
notes: Approximation: in a correction (>=15% below 90-day high), the correction low is at least 3 bars old and not undercut, today +1.5% on higher volume; distribution-day count exit replaced by a falling-50-day break.

name: Williams VIX Fix bottom finder
author: Larry Williams / ChrisMoody (TradingView)
summary: Synthetic VIX from price: buy when (22-day highest close - low)/highest close spikes above its 20-day Bollinger upper band or 85% of its 50-day high.
long_entry: (100 * (highest(close, 22) - low) / highest(close, 22)) >= sma((100 * (highest(close, 22) - low) / highest(close, 22)), 20) + 2 * stdev((100 * (highest(close, 22) - low) / highest(close, 22)), 20) | (100 * (highest(close, 22) - low) / highest(close, 22)) >= 0.85 * highest((100 * (highest(close, 22) - low) / highest(close, 22)), 50)
notes: Indicator marks bottoms only; exit at a new 10-day closing high added.

name: Weinstein Stage 2 (30-week MA)
author: Stan Weinstein (Secrets for Profiting in Bull and Bear Markets)
summary: Buy Stage 2 breakouts: price closes above resistance with the 30-week MA turning up on strong volume; sell when price falls back under the MA (Stage 3/4).
long_entry: close > highest(high, 60, 1) & close > sma(close, 210) & sma(close, 210) > shift(sma(close, 210), 7) & volume > sma(volume, 50)
short_entry: close < lowest(low, 60, 1) & close < sma(close, 210) & sma(close, 210) < shift(sma(close, 210), 7)
notes: 30 weeks = 210 daily bars; base resistance = 60-day high; Mansfield RS vs index dropped.

name: Elder Force Index pullback (2-day FI < 0 in uptrend)
author: Alexander Elder (Trading for a Living)
summary: In an uptrend (22-day EMA rising), buy when the 2-day EMA of Force Index dips below zero; Elder's classic triple-screen entry.

name: Elder-Ray bull/bear power
author: Alexander Elder (Trading for a Living)
summary: Buy when the 13-day EMA is rising and Bear Power (low - EMA13) is negative but rising; sell short when EMA falls and Bull Power is positive but falling.
long_entry: ema(close, 13) > shift(ema(close, 13), 1) & low - ema(close, 13) < 0 & low - ema(close, 13) > shift(low - ema(close, 13), 1)
short_entry: ema(close, 13) < shift(ema(close, 13), 1) & high - ema(close, 13) > 0 & high - ema(close, 13) < shift(high - ema(close, 13), 1)
notes: Divergence refinements omitted.

name: Coppock Curve upturn below zero (daily translation)
author: Edwin Coppock (Barron's)
summary: Buy when the Coppock curve (WMA10 of ROC14+ROC11, monthly) turns up from below zero, signalling a major bear-market bottom.
long_entry: wma(roc(close, 420) + roc(close, 330), 300) < 0 & wma(roc(close, 420) + roc(close, 330), 300) > shift(wma(roc(close, 420) + roc(close, 330), 300), 1)
long_exit: wma(roc(close, 420) + roc(close, 330), 300) > 0 & wma(roc(close, 420) + roc(close, 330), 300) < shift(wma(roc(close, 420) + roc(close, 330), 300), 1)
notes: Monthly lengths converted to days (x30): ROC 420/330, WMA 300. Original has no sell rule; exit when the curve turns down above zero.

name: Pring Know Sure Thing crossover
author: Martin Pring
summary: Weighted sum of four smoothed ROCs (10/15/20/30); buy when KST crosses above its 9-day signal, sell when it crosses below.
long_entry: cross_above((sma(roc(close, 10), 10) + 2 * sma(roc(close, 15), 10) + 3 * sma(roc(close, 20), 10) + 4 * sma(roc(close, 30), 15)), sma((sma(roc(close, 10), 10) + 2 * sma(roc(close, 15), 10) + 3 * sma(roc(close, 20), 10) + 4 * sma(roc(close, 30), 15)), 9))
long_exit: cross_below((sma(roc(close, 10), 10) + 2 * sma(roc(close, 15), 10) + 3 * sma(roc(close, 20), 10) + 4 * sma(roc(close, 30), 15)), sma((sma(roc(close, 10), 10) + 2 * sma(roc(close, 15), 10) + 3 * sma(roc(close, 20), 10) + 4 * sma(roc(close, 30), 15)), 9))

name: TRIX signal-line crossover
author: Jack Hutson (TASC)
summary: One-bar ROC of a triple-smoothed 15 EMA; buy when TRIX crosses above its 9-period signal, sell on the cross below.

name: Bill Williams Awesome Oscillator zero-line cross
author: Bill Williams (Trading Chaos)
summary: AO = SMA5 - SMA34 of the bar midpoint; long when it crosses above zero, short when it crosses below.

name: Bill Williams Alligator awake
author: Bill Williams (Trading Chaos)
summary: Trade when the Alligator 'eats': price above Lips above Teeth above Jaw (displaced smoothed medians); exit when the lines intertwine.
long_entry: close > shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 9), 3) & shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 9), 3) > shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 15), 5) & shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 15), 5) > shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 25), 8)
short_entry: close < shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 9), 3) & shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 9), 3) < shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 15), 5) & shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 15), 5) < shift(ema((high + low) / 2, 25), 8)
notes: SMMA(n) approximated by EMA(2n-1): 13->25, 8->15, 5->9; displacement via shift.

name: Guppy Multiple Moving Average separation
author: Daryl Guppy
summary: Long when the whole short-term EMA group (3-15) sits above the whole long-term group (30-60); exit when the short group falls into/below the long group.
long_entry: min(min(min(ema(close, 3), ema(close, 5)), min(ema(close, 8), ema(close, 10))), min(ema(close, 12), ema(close, 15))) > max(max(max(ema(close, 30), ema(close, 35)), max(ema(close, 40), ema(close, 45))), max(ema(close, 50), ema(close, 60)))
long_exit: min(min(min(ema(close, 3), ema(close, 5)), min(ema(close, 8), ema(close, 10))), min(ema(close, 12), ema(close, 15))) < min(min(min(ema(close, 30), ema(close, 35)), min(ema(close, 40), ema(close, 45))), min(ema(close, 50), ema(close, 60)))

name: Larry Williams Ultimate Oscillator
author: Larry Williams
summary: Buy when UO has been oversold (< 30) and then breaks back above 50; exit when UO > 70 (overbought).
long_entry: shift(lowest((100 * (4 * sma((close - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 7) / sma((max(high, shift(close, 1)) - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 7) + 2 * sma((close - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 14) / sma((max(high, shift(close, 1)) - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 14) + sma((close - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 28) / sma((max(high, shift(close, 1)) - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 28)) / 7), 10), 1) < 30 & cross_above((100 * (4 * sma((close - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 7) / sma((max(high, shift(close, 1)) - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 7) + 2 * sma((close - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 14) / sma((max(high, shift(close, 1)) - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 14) + sma((close - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 28) / sma((max(high, shift(close, 1)) - min(low, shift(close, 1))), 28)) / 7), 50)

name: Chaikin Money Flow +/-0.05
author: Marc Chaikin
summary: Buy when 20-day CMF shows sustained accumulation (> +0.05), exit/short on distribution (< -0.05).
notes: Volume is USD turnover rather than units; ratio is unaffected.

name: Money Flow Index 20/80 reversal
author: Gene Quong / Avrum Soudack
summary: Volume-weighted RSI: buy when MFI(14) < 20 (oversold), sell when > 80.

name: Fosback Negative Volume Index > 255-day EMA
author: Norman Fosback (Stock Market Logic)
summary: Smart money is active on falling-volume days; bull market odds ~96% when NVI is above its 255-day EMA.
notes: Needs a cumulative product (NVI) which the vocabulary cannot build.

name: Wilder Parabolic SAR stop-and-reverse
author: J. Welles Wilder (New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems)
summary: Always in the market: long while price is above the parabolic SAR (0.02 step, 0.2 max), reverse short when it is hit.

name: Wilder DMI crossover with ADX > 25
author: J. Welles Wilder
summary: Buy when +DI crosses above -DI while ADX > 25 (trend present), exit on the opposite cross; short mirror.
notes: Wilder's extreme-point rule simplified to opposite cross.

name: Chandelier Exit flip system (22, 3 ATR)
author: Chuck LeBeau / Alexander Elder
summary: Long while price stays above highest-high(22) - 3 ATR; flip short when it closes below, long again on a close above lowest-low(22) + 3 ATR (popular TradingView 'Chandelier Exit').

name: Cardwell/Brown RSI bull-range regime
author: Andrew Cardwell / Constance Brown
summary: RSI in a bull market holds 40-50 as support and reaches 70-90; stay long while RSI(14) holds above 40 after entering the bull range (> 60); exit on a break below 40.

name: Hikkake inside-bar false breakout (Chesler)
author: Daniel Chesler
summary: Inside bar, then a breakout bar that fails; enter in the opposite direction when price closes back through the inside bar's other side.
long_entry: shift(high, 2) < shift(high, 3) & shift(low, 2) > shift(low, 3) & shift(low, 1) < shift(low, 2) & shift(high, 1) < shift(high, 2) & close > shift(high, 2)
short_entry: shift(high, 2) < shift(high, 3) & shift(low, 2) > shift(low, 3) & shift(high, 1) > shift(high, 2) & shift(low, 1) > shift(low, 2) & close < shift(low, 2)
notes: Only the one-bar-after-false-break variant (Chesler allows up to 3 bars); exits are a 3-bar trail or 10-day extreme.

name: Inside-bar (mother bar) breakout
author: Price-action community (Nial Fuller et al.)
summary: After an inside bar, trade a close beyond the mother bar's high (long) or low (short) as compression releases.
long_entry: shift(high, 1) < shift(high, 2) & shift(low, 1) > shift(low, 2) & close > shift(high, 2)
short_entry: shift(high, 1) < shift(high, 2) & shift(low, 1) > shift(low, 2) & close < shift(low, 2)
notes: Exit on a close through the prior bar's opposite extreme (not given by source).

name: Key reversal day
author: Classical chartists
summary: Bullish key reversal: a new low below the prior bar that closes above the prior bar's high; bearish mirror at highs.
notes: 'At a trend extreme' = new 10-day extreme; strict close beyond the prior bar's range; exits are added stops/targets.

name: Wyckoff spring / upthrust in a trading range
author: Richard Wyckoff (via LuxAlgo)
summary: Inside a sideways range, a dip under support that closes back inside is a spring (buy); a push above resistance that closes back inside is an upthrust (short); target the other side.
long_entry: (highest(high, 40, 1) - lowest(low, 40, 1)) / close < 0.3 & low < lowest(low, 40, 1) & close > lowest(low, 40, 1)
short_entry: (highest(high, 40, 1) - lowest(low, 40, 1)) / close < 0.3 & high > highest(high, 40, 1) & close < highest(high, 40, 1)
notes: Trading range = 40-day range narrower than 30% of price; volume tests omitted.

name: Minervini Volatility Contraction Pattern breakout
author: Mark Minervini
summary: In an uptrend, buy the pivot breakout of a base whose pullbacks contract (each about half the last) with volume drying up, on above-average volume.
long_entry: close > sma(close, 200) & (highest(high, 10, 1) - lowest(low, 10, 1)) < 0.5 * (highest(high, 30, 11) - lowest(low, 30, 11)) & close > highest(high, 10, 1) & volume > sma(volume, 50)
notes: Contraction approximated as last-10-day range under half the prior-30-day range; 50-day exit.

name: Turnaround Tuesday
author: Quantified Strategies
summary: Buy at the close of a down Monday and sell at the close of Tuesday; 56% winners on SPY with 2.5% exposure.
notes: Rules (behind paywall) taken as the commonly published version; Monday is a calendar day in crypto.

name: Bitcoin halving-cycle positioning
author: Crypto community (via LuxAlgo)
summary: Hold BTC from the halving until roughly 12-18 months after it (de-risk as the cycle top approaches), re-accumulate in the deep drawdown phase before the next halving.
notes: 18 months ~ 540 days; re-accumulation from ~900 days (about 2.5 years after halving, ~1.5 years before the next).

name: Negative funding while price holds (short-squeeze setup)
author: Crypto derivatives traders (via LuxAlgo)
summary: When perp funding is negative while price holds or climbs, shorts are paying into strength; go long for the squeeze, exit when funding becomes crowded long.
notes: Exit threshold (2-sigma rich funding) added; source is descriptive.

name: Halloween indicator / Sell in May (applied to BTC)
author: Bouman & Jacobsen / market adage
summary: Hold from November through April and stay out May to October.

name: Santa Claus rally window
author: Yale Hirsch (Stock Trader's Almanac)
summary: Long over the last five trading days of December and the first two of January.
notes: Calendar days used for crypto.

short_exit: wma(2 * wma(close, 24) - wma(close, 49), 7) > shift(wma(2 * wma(close, 24) - wma(close, 49), 7), 1)

name: MACD-V momentum zones (Spiroglou)
author: Alex Spiroglou
summary: ATR-normalised MACD: rallying momentum when MACD-V is above +50 and above its signal; exit when it rolls under its signal or overextends past +150 and turns.

name: Bitcoin 9-day EMA crossover
author: Quantified Strategies
summary: Quantified Strategies' 9 EMA crossover system applied to Bitcoin: long when price closes above the 9-day EMA, out when below.
notes: Exact rules behind paywall; the standard price/9-EMA crossover is assumed.

name: Golden cross / death cross 50/200
author: Classical (popular for BTC on social media)

author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)

author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)

long_entry: low <= lowest(low, 10) & (high - low) >= highest(high - low, 10) & close >= low + 0.75 * (high - low)

author: Larry Connors
summary: When the RSI of the VIX spikes above an overbought level (fear), buy; when it falls below oversold, sell short; hold about 7-12 days.

summary: Buy when VIX is at least 10% above its 10-day SMA (panic), short when 10% below; exit when VIX crosses yesterday's MA.
notes: Source uses VIX low/high vs MA; daily VIX close used.

name: MACD cross armed by RSI extreme
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: An RSI(14) reading below 30 arms a long that triggers on the next MACD bullish cross (above 70 arms a short on the next bearish cross); 2% stop.
notes: 'Armed until the next MACD cross' approximated by an RSI extreme within the last 10 bars.

name: Stochastic RSI + SuperTrend trend filter
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Long when close is above the trend MA, SuperTrend is up and Stoch RSI %K crosses above %D below 20; exit on the opposite crossover.
long_entry: close > sma(close, 50) & supertrend_dir(10, 3) > 0 & sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3) < 0.2 & cross_above(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), sma(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), 3))
long_exit: cross_below(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), sma(sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3), 3)) & sma((rsi(close, 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)) / (highest(rsi(close, 14), 14) - lowest(rsi(close, 14), 14)), 3) > 0.8
notes: Trend MA length (50) and SuperTrend (10,3) defaults assumed; exit taken in the overbought zone.

name: EMA 50/200 + MACD cross + RSI band
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Buy when EMA50 > EMA200, MACD crosses above signal and RSI is between 45 and 70; sell short on the mirror (RSI 30-55); reverse on opposite signal.
long_entry: ema(close, 50) > ema(close, 200) & cross_above(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)) & rsi(close, 14) > 45 & rsi(close, 14) < 70
long_exit: ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) & cross_below(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)) & rsi(close, 14) > 30 & rsi(close, 14) < 55
short_entry: ema(close, 50) < ema(close, 200) & cross_below(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)) & rsi(close, 14) > 30 & rsi(close, 14) < 55
short_exit: ema(close, 50) > ema(close, 200) & cross_above(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)) & rsi(close, 14) > 45 & rsi(close, 14) < 70

name: 80-20 candle (open/close at opposite extremes)
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Long when a bar opens in its bottom 20% and closes in its top 20%, short on the mirror; the opposite signal reverses.
long_entry: close >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) & open <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
long_exit: open >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) & close <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
short_entry: open >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) & close <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
short_exit: close >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) & open <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
notes: Momentum reading of the 80-20 bar (Raschke's original fades it the next day).

name: Buy The Dips Trend (EMA 50/200, TP 0.7%, SL 2%)
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Buy when EMA50 crosses above EMA200 (short on cross below) with a tight 0.7% take profit and 2% stop.

name: Consecutive closes below EMA, buy the dip
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Buy after N consecutive closes below a moving average; exit when the close exceeds the previous bar's high.
long_entry: close < ema(close, 20) & shift(close, 1) < shift(ema(close, 20), 1) & shift(close, 2) < shift(ema(close, 20), 2)
notes: N = 3 and EMA(20) assumed (defaults not stated).

name: Altcoin/index EMA trend agreement (ETH with BTC)
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Trade an altcoin only when both its own EMA47 > EMA50 and the reference index (BTC) shows the same; short when both are below.
notes: Reference index taken as BTC.

name: ETH/USDT EMA 20/50 crossover with filters
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Long ETH when EMA20 crosses above EMA50 with price > EMA200, RSI > 30, ATR above its average and volume above average; short on the mirror; always reverse.
long_entry: cross_above(ema(close, 20), ema(close, 50)) & close > ema(close, 200) & rsi(close, 14) > 30 & atr(14) > sma(atr(14), 14) & volume > sma(volume, 14)
short_entry: cross_below(ema(close, 20), ema(close, 50)) & close < ema(close, 200) & rsi(close, 14) < 70 & atr(14) > sma(atr(14), 14) & volume > sma(volume, 14)

name: Pi Cycle top + Pi Cycle bottom (ATH/ATL)
author: Intelle_city (TradingView) / Philip Swift concept
summary: Buy when the 471-day SMA x 0.745 crosses above the 150-day EMA (Pi Cycle bottom), sell when the 111-day SMA crosses above 2x the 350-day SMA (Pi Cycle top).
notes: 0.745 scaling is the community Pi Cycle Bottom constant (not printed on the StockSharp page).

name: Kevin Davey Keltner channel reversal
author: Kevin Davey (Building Winning Algorithmic Trading Systems)
summary: Buy when the close falls below the lower Keltner band (EMA10, 1.6 ATR), sell short when it rises above the upper band; always in.
notes: Source ATR length 14 vs EMA 10; vocab kc uses one length.

name: RSI + MACD long-only combo
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Long when RSI crosses above 50 with MACD bullish, or MACD crosses above signal with RSI > 50; exit when RSI drops below 50 or MACD crosses down with histogram <= 0; TP 11.5%, SL 2.5%.

name: Andrea Unger Weekly Factor breakout
author: Andrea Unger (World Cup Trading Champion)
summary: When the 5-day candle body is small relative to its range (compression, factor 0.5), trade the next breakout of the prior session's high/low and exit at the next session.
long_entry: shift(abs(shift(open, 4) - close), 1) < 0.5 * shift(highest(high, 5) - lowest(low, 5), 1) & close > shift(high, 1)
short_entry: shift(abs(shift(open, 4) - close), 1) < 0.5 * shift(highest(high, 5) - lowest(low, 5), 1) & close < shift(low, 1)
notes: Compression test taken as |open 5 days ago - close| < 0.5 x 5-day range (Unger's formulation as commonly published); intraday stop entry approximated by close beyond prior high/low; one-day hold.

name: Triple CCI + MFI confirmed
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Long when the fast CCI(14) crosses above 0 while CCI(25) and CCI(50) are positive, MFI > 50 and close > EMA50; trail with an EMA after ATR activation.
long_entry: cross_above(cci(14), 0) & cci(25) > 0 & cci(50) > 0 & mfi(14) > 50 & close > ema(close, 50)
notes: ATR activation/trailing-EMA mechanics simplified.

name: Ichimoku + RSI + MACD
author: TradingView community author (ported by StockSharp)
summary: Long when price is above the cloud, RSI < 70 and MACD crosses above signal; short below the cloud with RSI > 30 and a bearish cross; exit on the opposite MACD cross.
long_entry: close > max(ichi_span_a(), ichi_span_b()) & rsi(close, 14) < 70 & cross_above(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9))
short_entry: close < min(ichi_span_a(), ichi_span_b()) & rsi(close, 14) > 30 & cross_below(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9))

name: Kathy Lien double Bollinger Band zones
author: Kathy Lien
summary: Buy zone is between the 1-sd and 2-sd upper bands: go long when price closes into it, stay out when it falls back into the neutral zone; short in the lower zone.

name: DiNapoli 3x3 displaced MA trend
author: Joe DiNapoli (Trading with DiNapoli Levels)
summary: The 3-period SMA displaced 3 bars forward acts as a trend thrust line: long while price closes above it, short while below.

name: Connors RSI (CRSI) composite
author: Larry Connors / Connors Research
summary: Average of RSI(3), RSI(2) of the up/down streak and the 100-day percent rank of the 1-day return; buy very low CRSI readings (< 10-15) in uptrends.
notes: Streak count and percent-rank functions are not in the vocabulary.

name: Williams %R -80/-20 cross
author: Larry Williams
summary: Buy when %R(14) climbs back above -80 out of oversold, sell when it falls back below -20 from overbought.

name: Pin bar (hammer) at a 20-day low
author: Price-action community
summary: A bar making a new 20-day low whose lower tail is at least two-thirds of the range and that closes in its top third signals rejection; buy, stop under the tail.
long_entry: low <= lowest(low, 20) & (min(open, close) - low) >= 0.66 * (high - low) & close >= low + 0.66 * (high - low)
short_entry: high >= highest(high, 20) & (high - max(open, close)) >= 0.66 * (high - low) & close <= high - 0.66 * (high - low)
notes: Exit rules added (tail stop approximated by 3-bar low, target at 20-day high).

name: Wide-range bar momentum thrust
author: Price-action community (via LuxAlgo)
summary: A bar with range > 2x its 20-bar average that closes in its top quarter marks a momentum thrust; follow it while price holds the bar's low.
long_entry: (high - low) > 2 * sma(high - low, 20) & close >= low + 0.75 * (high - low)
short_entry: (high - low) > 2 * sma(high - low, 20) & close <= low + 0.25 * (high - low)
